description: Land Title Settlement Department - Gangasiripura, Tissamaharamaya D/S Division, Hambantota  District - Cad. Map No. 830070
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters, specifically the determination of land ownership for specific parcels in Hambantota District under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed land parcel numbers, owner information, extent of land, and title classifications, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
